policy: No gate below may be marked PASS without real, founder-supplied evidence. Automated test/build results never satisfy a human gate. Each gate is classified AUTOMATABLE / HUMAN_REQUIRED / HYBRID; CURRENT_STATUS is PASS / PARTIAL / NOT_PERFORMED / FAIL / BLOCKED and NOT_PERFORMED is never PASS. This file is read by backend `npm run acceptance:status`. actualResult, environment, evidenceReference, evidence_type, and performed_by must be real; leave EMPTY / null / NOT_RUN until the founder performs the gate.
installerNote: Installer rebuilt and signed 2026-09-10 at 03:59 (after the release artifact was lost from disk); hash rotated across all docs and verified against the file on disk at freeze time. The published hash MUST match the hash of the exact file the founder installs.

gates.title: Google OAuth login on the canonical origin (single browser flow + cross-browser check)

gates.expectedResult: Single-origin login, consent, deny path, refresh, logout, no cross-host mismatch, no email re-ask

gates.name: Live Razorpay hosted-link payment: exactly-once entitlement, no credentials exposed
gates.title: Live Razorpay hosted-link payment: exactly-once entitlement, no credentials exposed
gates.requiredAction: Pay once via the hosted link on the canonical origin; return; verify entitlement exactly once; replay gate
gates.expectedResult: Correct link, exactly-once grant, reservation preserved, replay rejected, no secrets exposed
gates.notes: Payment is FROZEN; live charge only for this gate. Pipeline proof = 16/16; regression = 15 files / 294 passed / 0 failed.

gates.title: Offline-mode accept/recover: disconnect, single offline state, reconnect, resume, close/reopen
